// This is the generator for the fixtures in this directory. It is not part of
// the build. The command and the reason for ceaf591 are in README.md.
package grpcclient

import (
	"context"
	"encoding"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/popododo0720/vws-console-api/internal/backend"
	"github.com/popododo0720/vws-console-api/internal/cloud"
	"github.com/popododo0720/vws-console-api/internal/resource"
)

const upgradeSource = "ceaf591"

type upgradeIdempotency struct {
	Source      string                       `json:"source"`
	Account     string                       `json:"account"`
	Subject     string                       `json:"subject"`
	Action      string                       `json:"action"`
	ClientToken string                       `json:"clientToken"`
	Request     resource.DetachVolumeRequest `json:"request"`
	Key         string                       `json:"key"`
	Fingerprint string                       `json:"fingerprint"`
}

type upgradeLabels struct {
	Source string            `json:"source"`
	Now    time.Time         `json:"now"`
	Labels map[string]string `json:"labels"`
}

type upgradeMidFlight struct {
	upgradeLabels
	VolumeID string `json:"volumeId"`
}

type upgradeReplay struct {
	VolumeID string `json:"volumeId"`
	OpID     string `json:"opId"`
}

type upgradeBudget struct {
	upgradeLabels
	Replay upgradeReplay `json:"replay"`
}

type upgradeHeld struct {
	upgradeLabels
	HeldVolumeID    string `json:"heldVolumeId"`
	HeldKey         string `json:"heldKey"`
	HeldFingerprint string `json:"heldFingerprint"`
	HeldOpID        string `json:"heldOpId"`
	PendingVolumeID string `json:"pendingVolumeId"`
	PendingOp       string `json:"pendingOp"`
}

type upgradeCompute struct {
	backend.Compute
	seen backend.Mutation
}

func (u *upgradeCompute) DetachVolume(
	_ context.Context, m backend.Mutation, _ resource.DetachVolumeRequest,
) (resource.Accepted[resource.VolumeAttachment], error) {
	u.seen = m
	return resource.Accepted[resource.VolumeAttachment]{}, errors.New("stop")
}

func upgradeMutation(
	t *testing.T, account resource.AccountID, token resource.ClientToken, req resource.DetachVolumeRequest,
) backend.Mutation {
	t.Helper()
	spy := &upgradeCompute{}
	svc := cloud.New(cloud.Config{Backends: backend.Set{Compute: spy}})
	if _, err := svc.DetachVolume(
		context.Background(), resource.Caller{Account: account, Subject: "dev"}, token, req,
	); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("the stub accepted the detach")
	}
	if spy.seen.Key == "" {
		t.Fatal("the kernel built no mutation")
	}
	return spy.seen
}

func upgradeParse[T any, PT interface {
	*T
	encoding.TextUnmarshaler
}](t *testing.T, s string) T {
	t.Helper()
	v, err := resource.Parse[T, PT](s)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return v
}

func TestGenerateUpgradeFixtures(t *testing.T) {
	dir := os.Getenv("VWS_UPGRADE_FIXTURES")
	if dir == "" {
		t.Skip("VWS_UPGRADE_FIXTURES is not set")
	}
	account, err := resource.Parse[resource.AccountID]("123456789012")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	inst := upgradeParse[resource.InstanceID](t, "i-0123456789abcdef0")
	now := time.Date(2026, 10, 23, 6, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	vol0 := upgradeParse[resource.VolumeID](t, "vol-0123456789abcdef0")
	model := resource.Instance{
		ID:            inst,
		OwnerID:       account,
		ImageID:       upgradeParse[resource.ImageID](t, "ami-0123456789abcdef0"),
		ReservationID: upgradeParse[resource.ReservationID](t, "r-0123456789abcdef0"),
		LaunchTime:    now.Add(-time.Hour),
	}

	write := func(name string, v any) {
		t.Helper()
		raw, err := json.MarshalIndent(v, "", "  ")
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		raw = append(raw, '\n')
		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, name), raw, 0o600); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}

	req := resource.DetachVolumeRequest{VolumeID: vol0, InstanceID: inst, Device: "/dev/sdf"}
	token := upgradeParse[resource.ClientToken](t, "detach-upgrade-1")
	m := upgradeMutation(t, account, token, req)
	write("idempotency.json", upgradeIdempotency{
		Source: upgradeSource, Account: account.String(), Subject: "dev",
		Action: resource.ActionDetachVolume.String(), ClientToken: token.String(),
		Request: req, Key: m.Key, Fingerprint: m.Fingerprint,
	})

	midRecord := detachRecordValue(detachRequestHex(m.Key), req.Device, now.Add(-10*time.Minute))
	midLabels, err := instanceUpdateLabels(model, map[string]string{},
		resource.ActionDetachVolume, m.Fingerprint,
		map[string]string{labelDetachPrefix + vol0.String(): midRecord}, now)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	write("detach-mid-flight.json", upgradeMidFlight{
		upgradeLabels: upgradeLabels{Source: upgradeSource, Now: now, Labels: midLabels},
		VolumeID:      vol0.String(),
	})

	devices := []string{"/dev/sdf", "/dev/sdg", "/dev/sdh", "/dev/sdi"}
	records := map[string]string{labelLaunch: "detach-upgrade-launch"}
	for i := range backend.MaxDetachReplays {
		vol := upgradeParse[resource.VolumeID](t, fmt.Sprintf("vol-0123456789abcdef%d", i))
		req := resource.DetachVolumeRequest{VolumeID: vol, InstanceID: inst, Device: devices[i]}
		mut := m
		if i > 0 {
			mut = upgradeMutation(t, account, upgradeParse[resource.ClientToken](t, fmt.Sprintf("detach-upgrade-%d", i+2)), req)
		}
		requestHex := detachRequestHex(mut.Key)
		op := fmt.Sprintf("%020x", i+1)
		records[labelDetachPrefix+vol.String()] = detachRecordValue(requestHex, devices[i], now.Add(-time.Duration(i+1)*time.Hour))
		records[labelDetachOpPrefix+vol.String()] = op + " " + detachFPToken(requestHex, mut.Fingerprint)
	}
	budgetModel := model
	budgetModel.Tags = map[string]string{}
	for i := range resource.MaxTags {
		budgetModel.Tags[fmt.Sprintf("k%02d", i)] = "v"
	}
	budgetLabels, err := instanceUpdateLabels(budgetModel, records,
		resource.ActionDetachVolume, m.Fingerprint, records, now)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	write("op-labels-budget.json", upgradeBudget{
		upgradeLabels: upgradeLabels{Source: upgradeSource, Now: now, Labels: budgetLabels},
		Replay:        upgradeReplay{VolumeID: vol0.String(), OpID: fmt.Sprintf("%020x", 1)},
	})

	heldVol := upgradeParse[resource.VolumeID](t, "vol-0123456789abcdef0")
	pendingVol := upgradeParse[resource.VolumeID](t, "vol-0123456789abcdef1")
	heldReq := resource.DetachVolumeRequest{VolumeID: heldVol, InstanceID: inst, Device: "/dev/sdf"}
	heldMut := upgradeMutation(t, account, upgradeParse[resource.ClientToken](t, "detach-upgrade-held"), heldReq)
	pendingReq := resource.DetachVolumeRequest{VolumeID: pendingVol, InstanceID: inst, Device: "/dev/sdg"}
	pendingMut := upgradeMutation(t, account, upgradeParse[resource.ClientToken](t, "detach-upgrade-pending"), pendingReq)
	heldRequest := detachRequestHex(heldMut.Key)
	expired := now.Add(-backend.ClientTokenWindow - backend.ClientTokenGrace - time.Second)
	heldOp := fmt.Sprintf("%020x", 9)
	heldRaw := map[string]string{
		labelDetachPrefix + heldVol.String():    detachRecordValue(heldRequest, heldReq.Device, expired),
		labelDetachOpPrefix + heldVol.String():  heldOp + " " + detachFPToken(heldRequest, heldMut.Fingerprint),
		labelDetachPrefix + pendingVol.String(): detachRecordValue(detachRequestHex(pendingMut.Key), pendingReq.Device, now.Add(-time.Hour)),
	}
	heldModel := model
	heldModel.Tags = map[string]string{"env": "prod"}
	heldLabels, err := instanceUpdateLabels(heldModel, heldRaw, resource.ActionCreateTags, "fp-tags", nil, now)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	write("held-record.json", upgradeHeld{
		upgradeLabels:   upgradeLabels{Source: upgradeSource, Now: now, Labels: heldLabels},
		HeldVolumeID:    heldVol.String(),
		HeldKey:         heldMut.Key,
		HeldFingerprint: heldMut.Fingerprint,
		HeldOpID:        heldOp,
		PendingVolumeID: pendingVol.String(),
		PendingOp:       fmt.Sprintf("%020x %s", 10, detachFPToken(detachRequestHex(pendingMut.Key), pendingMut.Fingerprint)),
	})
}
